definitions.gloss: literary world; literary circles; literary establishment
definitions.explanation: The world of established writers, critics, publishers, and literary prizes. Refers to the collective community and institutions of serious literature.

examples.japanese: {文壇|ぶんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文壇|ぶんだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That novel was highly regarded in the literary world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{文壇|ぶんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}め→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧、⟦{数々|かずかず}→数々：12722_kazukazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: She attracted attention in the literary world at a young age and received numerous awards.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (literature) and ⟦{壇|だん}→壇：23016_dan⟧ (platform/world). Specifically refers to the established literary community — the network of recognized authors, literary magazines, publishers, and awards that form the mainstream literary establishment in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文壇|ぶんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to debut in the literary world
- {文壇|ぶんだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active in literary circles
- {文壇|ぶんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重鎮|じゅうちん}: a leading figure in the literary world
- {文壇|ぶんだん}⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧: a bar frequented by literary figures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文学界|ぶんがくかい}: literary world — broader and less exclusive than {文壇|ぶんだん}
- ⟦{画壇|がだん}→画壇：23494_gadan⟧: art world — the equivalent for visual arts
- ⟦{分断|ぶんだん}→分断：11772_bundan⟧: division, severance — a homophone with unrelated meaning
